title: Traffic advisory issued for several roads in Delhi as wedding season begins

ai.summary: Delhi police issued traffic advisory for wedding season with over 27 marriage functions expected on four roads, bringing more than 12,000 guests and 5,000 additional vehicles.

facts.quote: The police said over 27 marriage functions are scheduled on SSN Marg (Bhati Mines Road), Bandh Road, Mandi Road and MG Road, bringing more than 12,000 guests.
